ValidationRule.description: If Business Decline Reason = Other then the agent has to fill Business team Decline Other reason manually.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Business_team_Decline_Reason__c), INCLUDES(cc_Business_team_Decline_Reason__c, "Other"), ISBLANK(cc_Business_team_Decline_Other_reason__c), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") ), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Card Cash Collateral Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Convert Credit Card Nature Application")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Business team Decline Other reason manually.
